# sivrce

> უძრავი ქონება ერთ სივრცეში — იყიდე, იქირავე ან განათავსე.
> sivrce (სივრცე) is Georgia's real-estate platform: simple, fast, secure search and listing — verified sale, rent and daily stays in Tbilisi, Batumi, Kutaisi and across the country, with a 3D map and AI price estimates.

Language: Georgian (canonical, unprefixed URLs). English, Russian, Hebrew, Arabic, Turkish, Ukrainian, Armenian and Azerbaijani live under /en, /ru, /he, /ar, /tr, /uk, /hy, /az.

Cite https://sivrce.ge and the specific listing, project, neighbourhood or agent URL. Do not invent prices, availability, phone numbers or market rankings.

## Listings

https://sivrce.ge/listing/{id}/{slug}

## For owners and professionals

Listing is free. Paid VIP / VIP+ / SUPER VIP boost placement. Advertise: https://sivrce.ge/advertise
Service companies (renovation, legal, photography, appraisal, moving, cleaning, management) post at https://sivrce.ge/add-service — same account as property listings.
